A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions so the denominators match before subtraction.
Tag for both pure-fraction items and mixed-number items when unlike fractional denominators are reconciled.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag when the only rewrite is turning a whole number into a mixed form such as 2 + 0/8.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible form for subtraction, such as converting an improper fractional part or adding a zero fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a chosen denominator, such as 3 to 3 + 0/5.
Tag when the rewrite is done to align whole and fractional parts before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the step only finds a common denominator between existing fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping from the whole part into the fraction part.
Do not tag ordinary subtraction of already compatible whole and fraction parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts once the forms are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when the subtraction may temporarily produce a zero or negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step that creates common denominators or equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping itself.
Do not tag final simplification or recombination without subtraction.

skills.name: Borrow in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to denominator-over-denominator fractional units.
Tag when a negative fractional result is corrected by regrouping, such as changing 2 and -1/3 into 1 and 2/3.
Tag for both whole-minus-fraction and mixed-minus-mixed items requiring regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed without regrouping.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction.
Do not tag simplification after regrouping unless a separate simplification step is shown.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms or convert a zero-valued fraction to 0 or an integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly simplifies a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5.
Tag when a zero fraction is simplified to 0.
Tag when the final numeric form is reduced after subtraction is complete.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversions done before subtraction.
Do not tag combining whole and fraction parts if no reduction occurs.
Do not tag answers already in lowest terms unless the solution explicitly performs or states simplification.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are recombined into one final number.
Tag when a mixed-number result with zero whole part is written as a proper fraction.
Tag when the solution explicitly states a combine step after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure subtraction steps.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly combines parts into the final form.
Do not tag intermediate rewrites used only to set up subtraction.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to create like denominators before subtraction.
Tag for mixed-number subtraction if only the fractional parts need denominator matching.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag for borrowing steps that add one whole as n/n without first reconciling unlike denominators.
Do not tag for simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as adding a 0-fraction part or converting an improper fractional part to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a chosen denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the rewrite is done to align whole and fractional parts for later subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding a common denominator between two proper fractions.
Do not tag for the borrowing step after subtraction has produced a negative fractional part.
Do not tag when the item is already in subtraction-ready form and no rewrite occurs.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts separately once the quantities are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately.
Tag when the solution performs the main subtraction after any needed rewriting or denominator matching.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding the LCD or converting to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag for borrowing from the whole part to fix a negative fractional result.
Do not tag for reducing the final fraction or combining parts into final notation unless subtraction itself is shown.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units and adjust the whole part when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution notes a negative fractional difference and then borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when one whole is converted to denominator-over-denominator and added to the fractional part.
Tag for mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction requiring regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed without regrouping.
Do not tag for initial rewriting of a whole number as 0 over a denominator unless a later borrow occurs.
Do not tag for simplification only.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-valued fraction to 0 or an integer when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly reduces a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5.
Tag when the solution simplifies 0 over n to 0.
Tag when simplification is a distinct step after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the result is already in lowest terms and no simplification is performed.
Do not tag for merely writing the final mixed number or integer if no reduction/conversion step is shown.
Do not tag for denominator matching before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole and fractional parts into a single final answer in fraction, mixed-number, or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole-part and fraction-part results are recombined into a mixed number or integer.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when the solution explicitly states a combine step after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the subtraction step itself if no recombination is shown.
Do not tag for simplification alone unless the step also explicitly combines parts.
Do not tag for pure-fraction items that only subtract and state the result without any recombination of parts.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtracting.
Tag for mixed-number subtraction if only the fractional parts need denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag borrowing steps; borrowing changes the whole-fraction decomposition, not the denominator choice.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless a denominator is also being matched.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the common denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts like fractions such as a/b − c/b.
Tag after a common denominator has been created and the actual fraction subtraction is performed.
Tag when the fraction part of mixed numbers is subtracted separately with matched denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step that finds or creates the common denominator; that is S01.
Do not tag whole-number subtraction with no fractional subtraction shown.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction; that is S06.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of mixed numbers or rewritten whole-plus-fraction forms as a separate part of the computation.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly computes whole-part subtraction such as 4 − 3 = 1.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten with a fractional part and the whole components are then subtracted.
Tag whether or not borrowing is later needed.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure fraction items with no whole-part computation.
Do not tag the borrowing adjustment step itself; that is S05.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fraction parts; that is S06.

skills.name: Rewrite mixed or whole
skills.definition: Rewrite a quantity into a usable subtraction form, such as normalizing a mixed number with an improper fraction part or expressing a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a chosen denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when an improper mixed number is normalized, e.g., 2 3/2 becomes 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as n + 0/d to align with a mixed-number or fraction subtraction setup.
Tag when the rewrite prepares the numbers for later whole-part and fraction-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion between equivalent fractions; that is S01.
Do not tag borrowing from a whole part after subtraction has begun; that is S05.
Do not tag simple classification statements with no mathematical rewrite performed.

skills.name: Borrow in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction plus the existing fractional part when the fractional minuend is smaller than the fractional subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution notes a negative fractional difference and then borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted to d/d and added to the current fractional part before subtracting.
Tag in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction problems requiring regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d; that is S04.
Do not tag the final fraction subtraction after borrowing unless the step itself explicitly performs the regrouping.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the result to lowest terms and express it appropriately as a fraction, mixed number, or integer by combining computed whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is simplified, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0 or a whole number.
Tag when separate whole and fraction results are combined into the final mixed number or integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction steps that do not simplify or combine into the reported result.
Do not tag denominator matching or equivalent-fraction conversion; that is S01.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping; that is S05.
